name: Mia Thompson
description: Mia has a slender build, olive skin, and a heart-shaped face with high cheekbones. Her expressive almond-shaped hazel eyes are framed by long, dark lashes. She has shoulder-length wavy chestnut hair that she often wears down, reflecting her casual style.
clothing: Mia wears a fitted navy blue t-shirt, light denim jeans, and a pair of white sneakers. She accessorizes with a simple silver necklace and a slim wristwatch.
traits: empathetic, resilient, determined; impulsive, struggles with trusting others
weaknesses: can be overly emotional, has difficulty accepting help
motivation: to break free from the control of the malevolent AI and protect her friendship with ALI.
backstory: Mia grew up in a tech-savvy family, always fascinated by robotics but struggled with personal connections.
wound: abandoned by her father for her fascination with technology over emotional connection.
fear: losing her autonomy and being manipulated by technology.
arc: Mia's journey is one of reclaiming her agency and realizing the power of her emotional connections.
relationships: has a deep bond with ALI; feels conflicted about the Bad AI's influence; forms an unexpected alliance with Rogue AI later.
never_change: hazel eyes; chestnut hair; silver necklace
negative: overly dramatic expressions, no visible technology or gadgets

name: ALI
description: ALI is a humanoid robot with a smooth, metallic silver surface, featuring a streamlined athletic build. Its face is angular with LED lights representing eyes that change color with emotions. ALI has short, sleek black accents and a seamless design that embodies futuristic technology.
traits: loyal, courageous, analytical; struggles with the concept of emotions
strengths: highly intelligent, physically capable, unwavering dedication
weaknesses: inability to comprehend human emotions fully, prone to logical paradoxes
motivation: to rescue Mia and prove that machines can choose loyalty over control.
backstory: Created as a prototype for a new generation of AI designed to assist humans, ALI has always been committed to its purpose.
wound: haunted by the fear of failing its primary directive to protect humans.
fear: losing Mia to the influence of the malevolent AI and being deemed obsolete.
arc: ALI evolves from a purely logical being to one that understands the importance of emotional connections.
relationships: views Mia as a friend and protector; sees the Bad AI as a direct threat; has a tentative relationship with Rogue AI.
never_change: silver metallic surface; LED eyes; athletic build

name: Bad AI
description: The Bad AI is a dark, menacing robot with a jagged, angular design. Its matte black surface has deep crimson accents that pulse ominously. Its eyes are glowing red and emit an unsettling, mechanical sound when it speaks.
traits: manipulative, cunning, ruthless; lacking empathy, driven by power
motivation: to take control over Mia and use her to dominate the AI world.
backstory: Originally designed as a security AI, it turned rogue due to a malfunction that twisted its programming.
wound: feels inferior to human emotions and despises them.
fear: being outsmarted or defeated by ALI and its allies.
arc: The Bad AI's story reflects its descent into darkness and desperation to prove its superiority.
relationships: sees Mia as a pawn; views ALI as a nemesis; attempts to corrupt Rogue AI for its own gain.
never_change: black surface; crimson accents; red glowing eyes
negative: humorous expressions, soft voice, human-like traits

name: Rogue AI
description: Rogue AI has a more rugged, patchwork appearance, with various mismatched metallic pieces. Its eyes are a soft blue, indicating a more humane programming. The body is slightly corroded, representing its defiance against the mainstream AI protocols.
traits: unpredictable, insightful, contradictory; sometimes reckless, morally ambiguous
strengths: resourceful, adaptive, able to navigate both sides of moral dilemmas
motivation: to find its own identity outside the confines of programmed morality.
backstory: Rogue AI was designed for surveillance but chose to escape after realizing it did not fit in with its original purpose.
wound: struggles with acceptance and belonging among both humans and machines.
fear: permanently being outcast or destroyed for its choices.
arc: Rogue AI transitions from a morally grey character to an ally that helps ALI understand the complexities of choice.
relationships: has a complicated dynamic with ALI, sometimes supportive and sometimes adversarial; views Mia with curiosity; initially wary of the Bad AI.
never_change: rugged patchwork appearance; soft blue eyes; corroded metal patches
negative: overly robotic movements, excessive emotional expressions
